# superset_report (Data Source)

Looks up a report or an alert by its name, for example to check its schedule or its last state. A name is unique per type, so an alert and a report can share it: set `type` to tell them apart. The report API needs the `ALERT_REPORTS` feature flag.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "superset_report" "weekly_sales" {
  name = "Weekly sales"
  type = "Report"
}

output "weekly_sales_last_state" {
  value = data.superset_report.weekly_sales.last_state
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the report or alert. The comparison is exact.

### Optional

- `type` (String) `Report` or `Alert`. Set it when an alert and a report share the name.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the report runs on its schedule.
- `chart_id` (Number) Identifier of the chart the report sends; null for a dashboard report.
- `crontab` (String) Schedule of the report, as a cron expression.
- `dashboard_id` (Number) Identifier of the dashboard the report sends; null for a chart report.
- `description` (String) Description of the report.
- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the report.
- `last_state` (String) State of the last run, for example `Success`, `Error` or `Not triggered`.
- `timezone` (String) Time zone of the schedule.
